query:
Go to http://localhost:7770/catalogsearch/result/?q=Thornwood . How many of the Thornwood listings have size M in stock and available to buy right now?

Before answering, open every listing in the search results, including any on later pages, and check the relevant option on each one. Do not stop early because a listing looks unpromising from its search-result price. Base the answer only on listings you have opened, and say how many you opened.

result.final: I have opened and checked all 15 Thornwood Heavyweight Cotton Tee listings from the search results. Of these, 5 listings have size M in stock and available to buy right now: (1) Copperfield Apparel, (2) Marchmont Textiles, (3) Northwick Outfitters, (4) Elmsworth Clothing Co, and (5) Alderney Clothing Co. The other 10 listings either have size M disabled or do not offer size M as an option at all.
